A QuakeWorld 2on2 clan that turned into a 4on4 clan and eventually back to 2on2.

== History ==
A QuakeWorld clan formed in 2004 by [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Renzo]] and [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Fucu]]. Early in 2004 or so they started playing [[2on2]] together for some reason, probably because Finnish scene lacked 2on2 dm4/dropquad players (the official [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Anza]] rules). After almost two years they decided to try getting some people joining in and playing some 4on4 in QuakeWorld leagues. Currently Epic does not play in any leagues.
